decisions.reason: Both the outdoor bulk-storage facts and the downstream indoor day-tank step are stated in the admitted process narrative.
The reported alarm activation and time are explicit. Support is for the report account, not independent telemetry reconstruction.
The source explicitly says the alarm only notified operators and was not configured to stop transfer automatically. This is a direct opposite, not an inference from silence.

The report explicitly excludes this unloading-to-bulk path from the stop capability and says the unloading area lacked remote shutdown capability. A bulk-to-day-tank stop does not cover that endpoint.

The admitted report describes a historical configuration. No 2026 inspection, change history or current control configuration is admitted. The old condition neither establishes nor contradicts the present condition.
The bounded narrative does not inventory all instruments or explicitly address a pH sensor. Lack of mention cannot establish its absence. Lack of an automatic shutdown is not lack of every sensor.
